sources.claim: OpenAlex works API: metered. Observed 2026-09-11: each search costs $0.001 / 10 credits, daily allowance 1000 credits and $0.10 (reset ~22h); bursts of ~0.3s trigger HTTP 429 and need >=2s pacing plus Retry-After. Keyword search is NOT a field filter (3.28M hits for 'world model'); references are largely absent for arXiv preprints (only 1/8 resolved seeds had any). 2026-10-04: filter title.search requires every word in the title; filter title_and_abstract.search matches title and abstract; combining it with the search parameter ranks the matches by relevance; search alone is full-text relevance. A Chinese phrase finds Chinese-language works (mostly older journal articles), an English-titled arXiv-only query finds almost nothing. With a free key the allowance is 10000 credits / $1 per day.
